name: Line Receiver
description: A wartime receiver and nothing more: she hears the net, and answers with her tracks or a flag. The fit of the cheap line vehicle, twenty years on.

name: Field Transceiver
description: A wartime transceiver, still soldiering: three kilometres of voice on a good day, and the platoon net runs on it.

name: Command Set
description: A modern VHF set that reaches across any battlefield this game draws. What limits it is never distance: it is the hills, the mast being shot away, and one day the enemy listening in.

name: Man-Pack Set
description: What a platoon can carry on somebody's back, with a whip aerial and a kilometre of voice on level ground. She hears the company net perfectly well; being heard back is the part that depends on where she is standing, and that gap is the whole reason infantry are told what to do before they set off.
